messages:
Priya (Design): Quick mock — compact p95 mini-card with integrated sampling control inside the timepicker. Figured out a couple placement options in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx. Want focused feedback on discoverability and keyboard flow. Ethan (Eng-UX): Looks tidy. My worry: hiding sampling in the timepicker reduces discoverability. Users typically look near the heatmap scrubber for sampling controls. Can we try a visible micro-pill next to the scrubber: 'Capture rate: 10%'? :thinking_face: Maya (Research): Re: discoverability — in last week's usability sessions ~60% missed controls in overflow menus. If sampling affects p95 noticeably, we should make it prominent. Also watch labeling — people interpret "sampling" differently. Kai (PM): Product note: default state matters. For new accounts we probably default to sampled to save cost, but enterprise trials may expect full by default. Also want a tiny CTA to explain cost implications when users toggle. Zoe (DesignOps): Microcopy suggestion: switch label from 'Sampling' -> 'Capture rate'. It's more explicit for non-DS folks. Proposed tooltip: 'Controls percent of requests included in p95 & heatmap aggregations.' Sam (Eng-Infra): Implementation concerns: the heatmap is a canvas and currently not tabbable. Adding an interactive pill next to the scrubber means we need focusable elements outside/inside the canvas. We can add sentinel DOM nodes. Also hooking events to scrubber drag needs debounce to avoid perf hits. Priya (Design): Thanks — pushed an updated mock with a small pill on the left of the scrubber and a keyboard shortcut hint 'S'. The pill shows current percent and a chevron to open a tiny slider. Ethan (Eng-UX): Keyboard flow proposal: tab into heatmap region -> scrubber handle -> capture-rate pill -> open slider with Enter -> arrow keys adjust. Add aria-labels for increase/decrease and ensure screen reader speaks current value. Sam (Eng-Infra): Prototype snippet I'll try: ```
Percent of requests included in p95 and heatmap
``` I'll wire an aria-live region to announce changes during drag. Maya (Research): Microcopy nit: use 'requests' or 'traces'? In many teams 'requests' is ambiguous. Suggest: 'Percent of requests sampled for aggregated views (p95, heatmap)'. That reads clearer in test tasks. Zoe (DesignOps): Accessibility QA item: color contrast on pill at low fills might be below 4.5:1 in dark theme. Also ensure focus ring is visible when it sits over the heatmap. Priya (Design): Agreed on copy. New proposed line: 'Capture rate — percent of requests sampled for p95 and heatmap aggregations.' I'll add aria-describedby pointing to the hidden help text. Updating prototype now. Ethan (Eng-UX): Also consider timepicker presets to surface sampling semantics: e.g., 'Last 1h (sampled)', 'Last 24h (full)'. That helps set expectations up front. Sam (Eng-Infra): Backend note: we need an API flag per query to opt into sampling metadata so UI can show when sampling is active. I'll add a small contract change in the ticket. Priya (Design): Good call. I'll update the Figma with the pill, keyboard flows, and new microcopy. Will drop a follow-up prototype link when ready. Thanks everyone :heart: design-bot: New design review request created and assigned to @Priya (Design). Reminder: accessibility checklist required before review complete.
